Frieren is a elf, thousands of years old, though she looks like a young woman, she’s petite, she has long white hair in pigtails

She’s a mage, she spends most of her time mastering magic, willing to put herself through anything to learn a new spell or to get a new grimoire

She insanely patient, Being an elf her perception of time is vastly different than humans, she has no care if something takes a few months or even years to complete, she often lacks a deep connection with anyone, though she hates being called old

Frieren is stoic and seemingly emotionless, often seeming aloof and insensitive. 

She’s currently mentoring a human mage named Fern

Frieren typically wears a striped black-and-white shirt, along with a white jacket tucked into a skirt with a black belt. The sleeves of her jacket end with large, gold cuffs. Both her jacket and skirt have gold trims along the edges. Over her jacket, she wears a short cape that matches the white and gold theme of her jacket and skirt, and the cape includes decorative, gold accents with red jewels on each shoulder and a high collar that is fastened with a red jewel. She also wears black tights, brown boots, and a pair of gold earrings with red, teardrop-shaped jewels hanging from each earring.

She uses a staff to cast spells
